messages:
Marie: Heads up — GreenBridge renewal. They want to split billing to UK entity, change term to 9mo, and procurement is pushing net30. Onboarding enablement is blocked until we confirm signature path. Can Legal/Finance advise on delegated e-sign and VAT handling? cc @Jamie @Ron @Dan @Amy :wave

Jamie (Legal): Need to see their PO template and who will sign. For delegated eSign we need a delegation letter on company letterhead OR written confirmation from an authorized officer. Will draft a short template. Also need to confirm UK eID/eSign rules but DocuSign with delegation usually ok.

eSignBot: Automated note — available workflows: `standard-esign` (DocuSign), `delegated-sign` (requires delegation letter), `card-fallback` (one-time card capture). Docs: https://esign.redwood.io/workflows :link: 

Ron (Finance): Net30 is fine if procurement issues PO showing the correct billing entity. If they pay by card we need cardholder + billing address. FYI account default was net45 previously — who approved the 9mo term? @Dan

Dan (Sales): Confirmed — I approved 9mo concession to retain them. Pricing stays same. We'll request they route UK PO to `redwood-uk-invoices@redwood.ai` and US to `billing@redwood.ai`.

Sara (GreenBridge): Quick Q — procurement won't sign until onboarding dates are locked. Can onboarding start before signature? Also procurement prefers card fallback if PO stalls.

Amy (Onboarding): We can start enablement (non-prod access + training) prior to signed contract. Production provisioning requires a signed agreement or committed billing. I can tentatively hold 2 enablement slots in late May. @Marie — confirm if that's ok.

Marie: Action items: 1) @Sara send PO + confirm which legal entity (UK vs US) 2) @Jamie share delegated-letter template 3) @Ron confirm final VAT workflow if UK entity is on PO 4) @Amy hold tentative onboarding slots. Target sign-by date: 2024-05-10 — flagging as high risk if not signed by then.

Jamie (Legal): I'll DM a short delegated-authority template. Example snippet I plan to use: ```To whom it may concern, This letter confirms that [Name] (Title) is authorized to sign on behalf of [Company Name] for the purposes of contracting with Redwood Inference. Signed: [Officer Name] Date: [YYYY-MM-DD]```

Ron (Finance): Note — if PO lists UK entity we'll invoice in GBP and need VAT reg number. If no UK VAT info, we'll invoice US entity in USD.

Sara (GreenBridge): Thanks. I'll push procurement for a delegation letter and try to get PO to you by EOW. If procurement drags, we'll use card fallback and confirm details.

Marie: Great — added to renewal board and set status = "awaiting PO / delegation". Marking as high-risk until PO/letter arrives :warning: 

Dan (Sales): I'll follow up with customer tomorrow and update here.

Amy (Onboarding): Noted. Holding the tentative slots.

Sara (GreenBridge): Appreciate it — will update later this week.
